text_block_list.text: Fashion is hard.

As a rookie trainer,
my days were spent scrambling to scout
Umamusume...
Yet somehow, I seemed to lack credibility,
and no one would really listen to what I
had to say.

After racking my brain and agonizing over it...
I wondered if dressing more properly might
give my words more weight... So,
grasping at straws, I came looking for clothes,
but—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me...
Are you having some trouble,
by any chance?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm North Flight!
An Umamusume from Tracen Academy, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That badge! That's a Trainer badge,
isn't it?
Such a clean, honest,
and dependable design...
It's simply wonderful!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, forgive me for springing that on you!
I just happen to be completely in love with
all things fashion.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If you're troubled over what to wear,
Trainer,
I'd be more than happy to give you some
advice!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
Yes, if that's alright with you, Trainer,
then absolutely!

Relying on someone younger felt a little
pathetic, but stylish as she was,
she looked like a shining savior to someone
lost in a fashion labyrinth—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—I see,
I see!
So you're looking for an outfit that will
help you earn the trust of Umamusume,
Trainer.

Thinking that "proper" probably meant high-end,
I also mentioned that I had scraped together
a pretty generous budget.
choice_data_list: Even if it's just psychological, I...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Mm-hmm,
understood!
I'd like to do a proper consultation,
so let's move somewhere else for a bit!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then...
Let's begin "Fu-chan's Fashion Advice"♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
First,
let's establish a vision.
What kind of look do you picture when you
think of "fashion that earns trust"?

What immediately sprang to mind was the
office workers I often saw at the station.
Dressed in suits,
they exuded an air of serious,
reliable professionalism.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, wonderful! There's plenty of variety,
and it's a universally flattering look.
Especially in business settings,
it projects just the right amount of
trustworthiness.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Does that not quite sit right with
you?
Business is perfectly fine, you know?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A businesslike relationship built around
accomplishing what needs to be done...
Isn't that also a valid form of trust?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...You have something different in mind,
don't you?
Let's take a step back and think more
openly...
What kind of trusting relationship do you
actually want to build?
choice_data_list: ...One where we can talk through e...

text_block_list.text:
If they share even the little things with me,
I can pick up on the feelings they can't
put into words.
I want to help them find their true
sparkle—
choice_data_list: A relationship where I can help ex...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see! In that case, the answer is simple♪
What you need, Trainer,
is... definitely a "suit"!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Though in this case,
I mean the verb "to suit"...
As in, "to fit, to be appropriate,
to flatter what you wear"!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You already have such wonderful "raw materials"
within you.
If we put together an outfit that truly
suits those qualities—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You will undoubtedly shine!
You'll naturally radiate an aura that makes
people want to trust you♪
choice_data_list: Can clothes really do all that?
Can clothes really do all that?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
They sure can!
—Because that's the power of fashion♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
With versatility in mind,
let's use the pieces you're wearing today
as a foundation and build a few different
coordinates around them!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
There's a concept in fashion about adding
and subtracting elements.
Depending on how you combine pieces,
you can dramatically transform the impression
you make.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
For instance, that cardigan.
If we want to steer its vintage patchwork
vibe toward chic rather than cute...
let's tighten the look with the inner
layer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Going with a charcoal grey preserves your
gentle, approachable aura.
Then,
we can match your accessories to the colors
in the cardigan... and—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Wow,
you look absolutely fabulous♪ It's brought
out your intellect while adding a wonderfully
mature touch!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course, this is just one suggestion.
Since your theme was "trustworthy," I styled
it in that direction.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, fashion is about freedom!
It's just that sometimes,
it's hard to come up with new combinations
on your own.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fashion is a tool to make your shining self—
the wonderful canvas that is you—
look even more stunning.
Let's explore all kinds of angles♪

And so... by the time we parted ways,
we had put together five "fabulous" outfits
for less than half of my planned budget.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I want to help expand their
possibilities."
I was truly moved by that mindset of
yours.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Please have confidence in yourself.
You're a wonderful Trainer♪
choice_data_list: Flight... thank you so much, really!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
I'm looking forward to seeing you at the
academy next time.

The next day...
I headed to the academy wearing the outfit
North Flight had styled for me.
Knowing I looked "fabulous" gave me an
effortless spring in my step.

text_block_list.name: Passing Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, Trainer! You look, like...
totally different today! Super stylish!

text_block_list.name: Passing Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, for real!
You give off such a "Trainer" vibe.
...Oh, hey,
mind if I ask you about a question on my
homework?

Just by changing my clothes,
the Umamusume were casually striking up
conversations with me. What's more,
I noticed that I was speaking with far more
confidence than usual.

Wanting to thank her,
I went looking for North Flight—
and found her at the starting line of the
2,000m track.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

—A shockwave whipped past right in front of
me.

I understood in an instant.
Her raw speed...
Its sheer brilliance,
its dazzling potential...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

Just before reaching top speed,
North Flight suddenly slowed down.
It looked as though she was capable of giving
so much more, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, working hard, are we... Oh.
Were you...
watching North Flight just now?

The moment I say it out loud,
a question crosses my mind.
Despite such obvious talent,
she doesn't have a trainer,
nor does anyone seem to approach her.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Look, it might not be my place to butt in,
but...
She's...
probably more than you can handle.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
North Flight...
she was born with a frail body.
No matter how talented you are,
if you don't have the physique to endure a
race... it's a lost cause.
